subject.title: fix(dashboard): restore Bay review handoff pressure

question: Should OpenClaw Bay again expose the bounded exact-review pressure and trend panel that the rollback removed, as a read-only observability feature?
rationale: The implementation restores a visible operational surface rather than repairing an established current-main contract, and the rollback context does not establish that restoration is already approved.

options.title: Sponsor the restoration
options.body: Accept the compact read-only Bay pressure panel once current-head real-behavior proof confirms it remains observational.

options.title: Keep current dashboard scope
options.body: Leave the rollback-era Bay surface unchanged and close this restoration proposal without merging it.

options.title: Request a narrower design
options.body: Ask for a smaller or differently placed observability presentation before considering the queue-history additions.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the restoration
recommendation.body: Accept the compact read-only Bay pressure panel once current-head real-behavior proof confirms it remains observational.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincentkoc authored the merged telemetry and Bay-trend provenance that this branch restores after the rollback.
